The transition sentence says pending earlier applications follow the existing process. It does not expressly make every change associated with such an application permanently ineligible for item (ii) relief, or specify the date on which pending status must be tested.

Neither candidate computes whether prior SFC approval is required when relief is unavailable. Their false outcomes correctly avoid that inference; the existing approval process and relevant FAQs are needed for a fuller duty determination.
The relevant FAQs, forms and checklists are referenced but not supplied. Their contents cannot be inferred from the two unbound dependency records, whose source hashes are null.
